message: Could Rohin’s reported raw-child Next-Steps example—carry unfinished work forward, then check what happened—help you examine what your earlier addition, Whisker nearly screaming, contributes beyond the list of emotions? Would closer thought clarify what that reaction conveys, or would trying one new sentence give better evidence? What thinking or writing step do you choose to perform now, and which detail deserves your attention? What observation in your prose would make you change that choice? What finding from your draft, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
